text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You won't get me this time! I'm gonna bust that sneaky trick of yours, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, back again so soon? All right, I'm more than happy to put you under my spell. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmph, play it cool all you want. Today, I've got a trusty helper by my side!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Nakayama? Now that's a surprise… To think my magic has even you bewitched!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not really… I just heard you do the best card tricks in the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That, and there's a big payoff if I can see past your ruse.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hishiama's gonna serve me up her special spicy offal stew that's the talk of the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahh, okay. Well, I have no qualms in playing my part. I have my pride as an entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hmph… You're not all talk. Nimble fingers, and you know how to pull someone's gaze.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You're really staring me down. All this flattery means I'll have to step up my game.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, was that your doing? So you can even control your opponent's breathing…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don't be so stiff. Look into my eyes and my eyes only. I've prepared a show just for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …Aw, geez. Fuji, time out!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whatever is the matter, Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but could we call this whole thing off? I just realized how embarrassin' it is calling someone to fight in my place.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sorry for draggin' you into this, Nakayama. I'll make you some of that stew regardless.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch… Just when things were getting interesting. Whatever… No harm done.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna hone my skills though, Fuji. And then… I'll be coming for you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sure thing. Feel free to drop by if you're looking to have a sweet dream. ♪
